text: Artificial intelligence is changing the way we create art, music, and writing. Today, AI programs can paint pictures in the style of famous artists, compose original songs, or write short stories in seconds. Some people worry this means machines are becoming more creative than humans. However, human creativity comes from real experiences, emotions, and personal struggles. Machines simply copy patterns from data they have seen before. They do not feel joy, sadness, or wonder. While AI can produce impressive results quickly, it lacks the soul and intention behind human work. Instead of replacing artists, AI can be a tool that inspires them. It offers new ideas and saves time, but the true spark of creativity remains human.
